name: Nocturnal-Col
description: The crust never rests here. Rivers of incandescent basalt vein the lowlands, ash climbs from vents along every fault, and beyond an ancient meteor crater the sky stays the color of a bruise.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
There is money in titanium, uranium, copper and iron and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
